```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, dplyr, lattice, readr, readxl, downloader, rio, plotly, knitr, pander, ggthemes, ggrepel, directlabels, gapminder, wesanderson, patchwork, mosaic, ggplot2, DT, scales, rnaturalearth, rnaturalearthdata, sf, magick, ggdist, ggrain, tidyquant, ggtext)
```


```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

viva <- read_csv("../data/VIVA February 3, 2026_.csv") %>%
  filter(row_number() > 2) %>%  
  filter(!is.na(Sex), Sex != "#NULL!", Sex != "NULL") %>%
  
  select(
    Sex, Age, Race, Children_1, Job, LengthMarriage_1,
    LSavg, ANXavg, CESDsum, MOODnegavg, MOODposavg, 
    WICSavg, SWLSavg, SMDailyTimeCont
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(across(c(Age, Children_1, LengthMarriage_1, LSavg, ANXavg, CESDsum, 
                  MOODnegavg, MOODposavg, WICSavg, SWLSavg, SMDailyTimeCont), 
                ~as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", .)))) %>%
  
  
  filter(!is.na(Age), Age <= 30, (LengthMarriage_1 <= 4 | is.na(LengthMarriage_1))) %>%
  mutate(Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Men", "Women"))) %>%
  drop_na(Sex) %>%
  slice(-c(1, 2))
```

## Demographics

```{r}
# Race breakdown
viva %>%
  group_by(Race) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(Percentage = (n / sum(n)) * 100) %>%
  pander(caption = "Participant Race Distribution")

# Job breakdown
viva %>%
  group_by(Job) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(Percentage = (n / sum(n)) * 100) %>%
  pander(caption = "Participant Employment Distribution")
```
```{r}
cat("### Frequency Distribution of Age")
viva %>%
  count(Age) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = (n / sum(n)) * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(Age) %>% # Keeps ages in order (18, 19, 20...)
  pander()

cat("### Overall Age Summary Statistics")
viva %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Age = mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Age = sd(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_N = n()
  ) %>%
  pander()

# 2. Children_1 Count and Percentage
cat("### Parenting Distribution (Children_1)")
viva %>%
  count(Children_1) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = (n / sum(n)) * 100,
    Children_1 = case_when(
      Children_1 == 1 ~ "Yes", # Adjust these numbers if your coding is different
      Children_1 == 2 ~ "No",
      is.na(Children_1) ~ "Missing/NULL",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Children_1)
    )
  ) %>%
  pander()
```

```{r}
cat("### Frequency Distribution of Marriage Length")
viva %>%
  count(LengthMarriage_1) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = (n / sum(n)) * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(LengthMarriage_1) %>% # Keeps ages in order (18, 19, 20...)
  pander()

cat("### Overall Marriage Length Summary Statistics")
viva %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Marriage = mean(LengthMarriage_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Marriage = sd(LengthMarriage_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_N = n()
  ) %>%
  pander()
```




## descriptive stats

```{r}
vars_to_analyze <- c("LSavg", "ANXavg", "CESDsum", "MOODnegavg", 
                     "MOODposavg", "WICSavg", "SWLSavg", "SMDailyTimeCont")

# Loop to create Descriptive Tables
for (var in vars_to_analyze) {
  cat("\n### Descriptives for:", var, "\n")
  
  viva %>%
    group_by(Sex) %>%
    summarise(
      Min = min(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE), 
      Q1 = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
      Med = median(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE), 
      Q3 = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 
      Max = max(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Average = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      StDev = sd(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      SampleSize = sum(!is.na(.data[[var]])) # Actual count of non-missing values
    ) %>%
    pander()
}
```
 
 
## t.tests

```{r}


vars_to_analyze <- c("LSavg", "ANXavg", "CESDsum", "MOODnegavg", 
                     "MOODposavg", "WICSavg", "SWLSavg", "SMDailyTimeCont")

for (var in vars_to_analyze) {
  cat("\n### T-Test for:", var, "\n")
  
  form <- as.formula(paste(var, "~ Sex"))
  
  t.test(form, data = viva, mu = 0) %>%
    pander()
}
```

```{r}
 library(lsr)

vars_to_analyze <- c("LSavg", "ANXavg", "CESDsum", "MOODnegavg", 
                     "MOODposavg", "WICSavg", "SWLSavg", "SMDailyTimeCont")

for (var in vars_to_analyze) {
  form <- as.formula(paste(var, "~ Sex"))
  
  # Calculate d
  d_val <- cohensD(form, data = viva)
  
  # Simple print
  cat(var, ": d =", round(d_val, 3), "\n")
}
```


##Plots


```{r}
make_final_rainplot <- function(df, var_name, full_label) {
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Sex, y = !!sym(var_name), fill = Sex)) +
    stat_halfeye(
      adjust = .5, width = .7, .width = 0, 
      justification = -.2, point_colour = NA
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(width = .15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8) +

    geom_jitter(aes(color = Sex), alpha = 0.3, width = 0.1, size = 1.2) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Men" = "steelblue4", "Women" = "thistle")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Men" = "steelblue4", "Women" = "thistle")) +

    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0.2)) + 
    
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = full_label) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
      # Removing extra plot margin at the bottom
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 0, l = 10) 
    )
}
```




```{r}
make_final_rainplot(viva, "LSavg", "Average Loneliness Score")
make_final_rainplot(viva, "ANXavg", "Average Anxiety Score")
make_final_rainplot(viva, "CESDsum", "Total Depressive Symptoms")
make_final_rainplot(viva, "MOODnegavg", "Negative Affect Score")
make_final_rainplot(viva, "MOODposavg", "Positive Affect Score")
make_final_rainplot(viva, "WICSavg", "Interpersonal Conflict Score")
make_final_rainplot(viva, "SWLSavg", "Life Satisfaction Score")
make_final_rainplot(viva, "SMDailyTimeCont", "Daily Social Media Use (Minutes)")
```






#flipped axis

```{r}
make_final_rainplot <- function(df, var_name, full_label) {
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = !!sym(var_name), y = Sex, fill = Sex)) +
    stat_halfeye(
      adjust = .6, width = 1.2, .width = 0, 
      justification = -.2, point_colour = NA
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(width = .1, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8) +

    geom_jitter(aes(color = Sex), alpha = 0.4, width = 0.1, size = 1.2) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Men" = "steelblue4", "Women" = "thistle")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Men" = "steelblue4", "Women" = "thistle")) +

    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0.2)) + 
    
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = full_label, y = "Sex") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(r = 15)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 0, l = 10)
    )
}
```



```{r}
#| warning: false
make_final_rainplot(viva, "LSavg", "Average Loneliness Score")
make_final_rainplot(viva, "ANXavg", "Average Anxiety Score")
make_final_rainplot(viva, "CESDsum", "Total Depressive Symptoms")
make_final_rainplot(viva, "MOODposavg", "Positive Affect Score")
```

















```{r}
viva_mood_layered <- viva %>%
  # Select only the columns needed for the comparison
  select(Sex, MOODposavg, MOODnegavg) %>%
  
  # Stack the variables into a "Long" format
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(MOODposavg, MOODnegavg), 
    names_to = "Mood_Type", 
    values_to = "Score"
  ) %>%
  
  # Clean up the names and add the numeric position for the tight plot
  mutate(
    Mood_Type = recode(Mood_Type, 
                       "MOODposavg" = "Positive Affect", 
                       "MOODnegavg" = "Negative Affect"),
    Sex_Num = ifelse(Sex == "Men", 1, 1.4)
  )
```



```{r}
# Re-establishing the tight but stable numeric positions
viva_mood_layered <- viva_mood_layered %>%
  mutate(Sex_Num = ifelse(Sex == "Men", 1, 1.4)) 

ggplot(viva_mood_layered, aes(x = Sex_Num, y = Score, fill = interaction(Sex, Mood_Type))) +
  # 1. The Clouds
  stat_halfeye(
    adjust = .5, width = .6, .width = 0, 
    justification = 0, point_colour = NA, alpha = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = .15) 
  ) +
  # 2. The Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    width = .08, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = .15) 
  ) +
  # 3. The Rain
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = interaction(Sex, Mood_Type)),
    alpha = 0.2, size = 0.7,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.05, dodge.width = 0.15)
  ) +
  
  # Colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Men.Negative Affect" = "steelblue4",   
    "Men.Positive Affect" = "lightsteelblue3", 
    "Women.Negative Affect" = "maroon4",    
    "Women.Positive Affect" = "thistle"     
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Men.Negative Affect" = "steelblue4", 
    "Men.Positive Affect" = "lightsteelblue3",
    "Women.Negative Affect" = "maroon4", 
    "Women.Positive Affect" = "thistle"
  )) +
  
  # 4. INTERNAL LABEL: This puts the text inside the plot at the bottom
  annotate("text", x = 0.75, y = 3, 
           label = "Negative Affect <——————————> Positive Affect", 
           size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +

  # Using coord_cartesian to crop while coord_flip handles the orientation
  coord_flip(ylim = c(1, 5), xlim = c(0.7, 1.7), clip = "off") +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 1.4), 
    labels = c("Men", "Women"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) + 
  
  # Set titles to NULL since we used annotate()
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    # Extra tight margins since label is inside
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 10, b = 15, l = 5) 
  )
```

```{r}
# Re-running the pivot if needed

ggplot(viva_anx_ls_layered, aes(x = Sex_Num, y = Score, fill = interaction(Sex, Var_Type))) +
  # 1. The Clouds
  stat_halfeye(
    adjust = .5, width = .6, .width = 0, 
    justification = 0, point_colour = NA, alpha = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = .15) 
  ) +
  # 2. The Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    width = .08, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = .15) 
  ) +
  # 3. The Rain
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = interaction(Sex, Var_Type)),
    alpha = 0.2, size = 0.7,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.05, dodge.width = 0.15)
  ) +
  
  # Colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Men.Anxiety" = "steelblue4", "Men.Loneliness" = "lightsteelblue3", 
    "Women.Anxiety" = "maroon4", "Women.Loneliness" = "thistle"     
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Men.Anxiety" = "steelblue4", "Men.Loneliness" = "lightsteelblue3",
    "Women.Anxiety" = "maroon4", "Women.Loneliness" = "thistle"
  )) +
  
  annotate("text", x = 1.65, y = 4.3, label = "— Anxiety (W)", color = "maroon4", fontface = "bold", size = 4.4, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.58, y = 4.3, label = "— Loneliness (W)", color = "thistle4", fontface = "bold", size = 4.4, hjust = 0) +
  # Men's Legend
  annotate("text", x = 1.25, y = 4.3, label = "— Anxiety (M)", color = "steelblue4", fontface = "bold", size = 4.4, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.18, y = 4.3, label = "— Loneliness (M)", color = "lightsteelblue4", fontface = "bold", size = 4.4, hjust = 0) +

  # THE SQUEEZE: xlim starts at 0.9 to cut off space below Men (who are at 1.0)
  coord_flip(ylim = c(1, 5), xlim = c(0.9, 1.75), clip = "off") +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 1.4), 
    labels = c("Men", "Women"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) + 
  
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 10, b = 2, l = 5) 
  )
```
